csharpDecision: CompilerApp selects a target-specific linker after common checked preparation. WasmBrowserLinker compiles target wasm with -g/-fno-addrsig then wasm-ld exports start/allocator/memory. WslLinuxLinker compiles Linux object, links via WSL cc on Windows or native cc, preserves shared flag and chmod executable. run only admits current host before build. Cache preparation is target keyed, not native-only.
slgDecision: Remove unconditional build-target rejection by giving CLI target-specific linking functions the same responsibility boundaries; common source/cache/checked-product path must admit target descriptors including wasm rather than disabling caches or duplicating the checked frontend. Existing wasm target diagnostics and borrowed APIs remain; common prefix/module/suffix emission must serve cached wasm. Linux cross-build follows WSL link stages, and run retains managed host-only admission. Existing Windows branch is a related control, not a claim that its partitioning/link implementation is already structurally identical.
